newsitem.title: USA: Brightpoint cites sales for Q1 net gain.
newsitem.headline: Brightpoint cites sales for Q1 net gain.

text.p: Brightpoint Inc said Tuesday increased sales and higher gross margins are the main reasons its earnings rose 119 percent in the first quarter ended March 31 compared to pro forma results last year.
The company, which distributes wireless communications products and equipment, said net income totaled $5.4 million, or $0.23 a share, versus $2.5 million, or $0.12, a year ago.
Sales in the period rose to $199.2 million from $113.0 million in the first quarter of 1996, Brightpoint said.
The company said it also realized a gain of about $8.3 million on the sale of an equity investment in Cellstar Corp, as well as unrealized losses on other investments worth a total of $6.9 million.
Brightpoint shares were up 1/8 Tuesday at 17-7/8.
